info.cls_ename: Department of Mechanical and Computer-Aided Engineering

description.describe_ch: 本門課程包含機械材料、破壞力學、機電整合等領域、教學的目標有二，（一）使學生瞭解陶瓷材料機械性質的優點，及其缺乏韌性的原因。（二）使學生具備壓電陶瓷的知識，即材料壓電能與機械能之間如何轉換。具備這些知識，將使學生能充分運用陶瓷在工業界各種領域。
description.describe_eh: This is an interdisciplinary course including knowledge in mechanical materials, Fracture mechanics, and Electro-mechanical interaction. The purpose of this course is twofold:(1)make students understand unique mechanical properties of ceramics, and the reason of lack of toughness；(2)teach students the knowledge of piezoelectric ceramics including the transfer between mechanical and electrical energies. With these knowledges, students are able to completely apply ceramics in various industrial fields.

targets.describe_ch: 能自行定義出何謂結構陶瓷、電子陶瓷及其重要性
targets.describe_en: Be able to define structural ceramics, electrical ceramics and identify their importance

targets.describe_ch: 瞭解陶瓷材料其微結構與性能的關係，及材料的優缺點
targets.describe_en: Understand the relationship between micro-structure and properties, advantage, and disadvantage of ceramics

targets.describe_ch: 理解陶瓷材料應用在高溫、半導體等領域的原理
targets.describe_en: Understand how to apply ceramics in high temperature environment and semiconductors

targets.describe_ch: 能應用破壞力學分析結構陶瓷、壓電原理分析電子陶瓷
targets.describe_en: Utilize fracture mechanics and piezoelectric principles to analyze behavior of ceramics
